changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Score') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Score]( [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsNewScore_EffectiveDate] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [Value] [decimal](5, 3) NOT NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, [EndDate] [date] NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScore] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetUid] ASC, [ScoreType] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) ) END
